title: Feature to production, by the book
scenario: "Customer service needs GET /api/products/:id. Unknown ids must return 404. It has to be in production this week, with evidence." — Product owner (FEAT-01)
mission: Ship FEAT-01 from a feature branch to production through PR, CI, a dev deploy PR, smoke, promotion and a prod deploy PR — with the same image.
objectives: Run the standard loop end to end
Promote the exact artifact that passed dev

steps.title: Dev deploy PR
steps.detail: app.yml builds, scans, pushes and opens the dev deploy PR. Merge it; wait for SMOKE OK.

steps.title: Promote
steps.detail: Run app.yml with promote_to_prod; merge the prod PR; wait for SMOKE OK in prod.

steps.title: Evidence
steps.detail: Paste the release-evidence block into the prod PR.

criteria.text: A FEAT-01 PR is merged to main with green checks
Dev and prod values reference the same API tag
Both PostSync smoke jobs logged SMOKE OK for that tag
GET /api/products/2 returns one product in prod

expectedResult: A feature in production with a complete audit trail of PRs and runs.

concepts.title: The standard loop
concepts.body: feature branch → PR → CI (tests, lint, scans) → squash merge → the app pipeline builds and pushes images → it opens a *deploy PR* that bumps the dev tag → merge → Argo CD syncs dev → PostSync smoke → promotion PR copies the same tag to prod → merge → prod smoke.

concepts.title: Build once, deploy many
concepts.body: Prod must run the exact artifact that passed dev. Rebuilding for prod could produce different bytes (dependencies changed overnight). Promotion therefore copies the tag (better: the digest) instead of building again.

example.title: reading what each environment runs
example.body: The environment values in Git are the source of truth for what is deployed:
example.code:
git show origin/main:gitops/envs/dev/values.yaml | Select-String -Context 0,1 "api:"
git show origin/main:gitops/envs/prod/values.yaml | Select-String -Context 0,1 "api:"

glossary.def: PR that only changes environment values (image tags).
Moving a verified artifact to the next environment.
Links to PRs, runs and smoke logs proving the release.

recovery: Smoke failed in dev: do not promote. Revert the deploy PR, fix forward.
dont: Do not build a second image for prod
hints: Which workflow input copies dev tags to prod?
The smoke job compares /api/info version with the expected tag.
Release evidence template is at the end of docs/E2E-FEATURE-FLOW.md.

interview.question: Walk me through your CI/CD from a feature branch to production in two minutes.
followUps: Why does CI open PRs instead of deploying?

debrief: CI never touches the cluster (ADR-0003): it writes Git, Argo CD pulls. Promotion copies the tag that passed dev, so prod runs the verified artifact. Every step is a PR with checks — that is the audit trail.

checker.plan: Read-only: gh pr list/view, git show for dev/prod values, kubectl logs of both smoke jobs, HTTP GET through Front Door or service proxy.

validation.notes: Checker not implemented yet; needs a running cluster.
